environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with direct TCP passthrough on port 443. TLS terminated at the application level using self-signed cert. No additional middleware or filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application process runs as ec2-user with standard Amazon Linux 2023 AMI. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume at /var/app/data/users.db.
